rationale: Y explicitly tracks and validates the two core ground-truth defects (AllGather-KV rank-local-Q/global-KV mismatch and packed-metadata SAGE trim logic), correctly recognizing that fixes for the AllGather-KV issue are already present and noting the residual scope concern that matches the ground-truth follow-up discussion. X touches the same guard but mischaracterizes it as unrelated scope creep rather than the accepted fix for a real known bug, and misses the SAGE-disable edge case entirely. Both reviews are well-grounded with concrete file/line evidence and near-identical, high-quality findings on the packed-path device-sync hot-loop issue; X's report is somewhat more readable/actionable due to clearer triage headers and inline suggested diffs, but this doesn't offset Y's stronger alignment with the actual reviewer concerns.
